summary: EXP-661 adds killshot/audit/review-response entries to monitor/config.json target.pages (3 new entries, no.html-suffix URL pattern matching the existing 7) and seeds monitor/baseline/08-killshot.txt, 09-audit.txt, 10-review-response.txt from a live fetch (all HTTP 200, 2026-07-11).
